title.purpose: Masthead and the one line that names a state.

body.purpose: Toggle labels, buttons, descriptions, every sentence the participant must read.

label.purpose: Status lines, help copy, facts, error and warning bodies.

micro.purpose: Format chips only. Nothing else is set below 11px.

shadows.name: overlay-rest
shadows.purpose: Cards and status overlays injected into a host page. Separates hard from a page that is not ours.

shadows.name: notice-rest
shadows.purpose: Dismissible research notice. One step softer than a card because it is informational.

motion.name: ease-out-entry
motion.purpose: Overlay and notice entry: opacity 0 to 1 with translateY(6px) to 0.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Toggle track background and knob translation.

motion.name: hover-transition
motion.purpose: Icon button background, border and color.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: Processing spinner in a status disc. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committing action in a block: start capture, save session, retry save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #527bbd; background: #295eb0; color: #ffffff; font: 400 12px/1.2 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f8cff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; background: #35373e; border-color: #555965; color: #c3c5cb; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Changes context without committing: assign task, go to capture tab, start over.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #555965; background: #35373e; color: #e8e8ea; font: 400 12px/1.2 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #3a3c42; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f8cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Discards a capture session. Always paired with a primary save action beside it.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #d58686; background: #693333; color: #ffffff; font: 400 12px/1.2 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f8cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Copy-to-clipboard receipt button with a confirmation state that swaps the glyph.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Copiar identificador" data-state="idle"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 9h10v10H9z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M15 9V5H5v10h4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 38px; min-height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #555965; background: #35373e; color: #c8c9cf; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-icon-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; display: block; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: #3a3c42; border-color: #4f8cff; color: #ffffff; } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f8cff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-btn[data-state='copied'] { border-color: #3ecf8e; color: #3ecf8e; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line field in the research flow: participation code, protocol, task id.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Código de participación <input class="ds-input" type="password" value="" autocomplete="off"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font: 400 12px/1.45 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #9a9ba1; } .ds-input { width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid #656873; border-radius: 5px; background: #18191c; color: #e8e8ea; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #7a7d88; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #4f8cff; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: 44x24 pill switch whose state word beside it is mandatory.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font: 600 13px/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #e8e8ea; } .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 44px; height: 24px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-slider { position: absolute; inset: 0; cursor: pointer; background: #4a4b52; border-radius: 24px; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-slider::before { content: ''; position: absolute; height: 18px; width: 18px; left: 3px; top: 3px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-slider { background: #4f8cff; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-slider::before { transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-slider { outline: 2px solid #4f8cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Popup Card
components.description: Flat 10px container in the 320px popup column. No shadow, no border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #26272b; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #e8e8ea; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 12px; color: #9a9ba1; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-card-state { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #3ecf8e; }

components.name: Status Overlay Card
components.description: Lifted card injected into a host page: gradient, hairline, ambient shadow and a status footer line.
components.html:
Procesando documento
Convirtiendo el archivo antes de enviarlo al chat.
components.css: .ds-overlay { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2a2c31 0%, #222327 100%); border: 1px solid #3a3c42; box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #e8e8ea; text-align: left; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-overlay::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #4f8cff, transparent); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-overlay[data-state='done']::after { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #3ecf8e, transparent); } .ds-overlay[data-state='error']::after { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #e05c5c, transparent); } .ds-overlay-disc { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(79, 140, 255, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(79, 140, 255, 0.32); } .ds-overlay[data-state='done'] .ds-overlay-disc { background: rgba(62, 207, 142, 0.12); border-color: rgba(62, 207, 142, 0.35); } .ds-overlay[data-state='error'] .ds-overlay-disc { background: rgba(224, 92, 92, 0.12); border-color: rgba(224, 92, 92, 0.4); } .ds-overlay-body { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; } .ds-overlay-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: #ffffff; } .ds-overlay-text { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; color: #9a9ba1; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Format Chip
components.description: Static inventory chip listing an accepted attachment format.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 20px; background: #33343a; color: #9a9ba1; font: 600 10px/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Error Notice
components.description: Inline failure block. Replaces silent failure; always carries a role=alert.
components.html: No se pudo procesar el documento.
components.css: .ds-error { margin: 0; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d58686; border-radius: 5px; background: #4a2020; color: #ffd0d0; font: 400 12px/1.45 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Everything the participant types or attaches crosses one inspection desk before it leaves the browser. The extension is that desk: a control booth in the popup, a stamp on the page in the form of the review card. The design has exactly one job — make the crossing legible. Nothing here celebrates, nothing threatens. A person mid-task should always be able to answer, at a glance, what will leave, in what state, and what to do next.

The surface is dark because the work happens beside a chat window that is usually light, and because a graphite panel recedes until it has something to report. Color is not decoration but verdict: a single Signal Blue for action and active state, then three status colors that only ever describe an outcome. When a card has nothing to say it is a flat #26272b rectangle with 10px corners and no shadow. Contrast comes from text weight and the hairline border, not from elevation.

Restraint is the aesthetic. Density is high because a 320px column must hold a toggle, a format list and a nine-state research flow; the answer is a strict 4px rhythm, 12–13px body text and one accent, never a wider canvas. Motion exists only to confirm a state change and is always removable. The system's characteristic gesture is the status disc plus the gradient hairline at the foot of an overlay card: a quiet instrument light that says 'processing', 'done' or 'blocked' without an alarm.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, one blue accent, three semantic status colors.
Flat cards inside the popup; lifted overlays on the host page.
Segoe UI at two weights, with a single monospace exception for identifiers.
Every state is named in Spanish, in words a non-technical participant can act on.
Motion: 160–180ms ease-out entries, instant removal under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is used on ≤10% of any given surface. If an element has no state to report and no action to take, it stays graphite. Its rarity is what makes "live" readable.

rules.name: The Verdict-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red never appear as brand, never as decoration, and never as a hover tint. They are a sentence about an outcome — nothing else.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Segoe UI and its system fallback. No display face, no second sans, no icon font — icons are inline SVG at 18px, or a single text glyph inside a disc. Monospace is permitted only for the research receipt value.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Text uses 400 and 600 only. A single 700 is allowed inside a 30–34px status disc, where a glyph needs weight to survive at that size.

rules.name: The Flat-Inside, Lifted-Outside Rule
rules.body: If it renders in the popup, it has no shadow. If it renders on a host page, it has a gradient, a hairline and a shadow. Never import the overlay treatment into the popup, and never ship a shadowless floating card onto someone else's page.

rules.name: The Small-Radius Rule
rules.body: 5–6px for controls, 10–12px for containers. Anything above 12px is either a chip or the switch. A 20px-radius card reads as a consumer app and is wrong here.

dos: Do name every state in words next to its color — "Activada", "Captura interrumpida", "No se pudo procesar el documento".
Do keep the 320px popup column and 12px card rhythm; resize copy to fit, not the surface.
Do use one Signal Blue action per block, and let secondary and danger actions recede.
Do give every overlay a 1px hairline, a gradient and the ambient shadow — that is how it separates from a page it does not own.
Do draw a 2px Signal Blue :focus-visible ring on every reachable control, and honour prefers-reduced-motion by removing entry animation and spinners.
Do let a card do nothing visually when it has nothing to report: flat fill, no accent, no shadow.
donts: Don't build security scare-UI: no shield iconography, no alarm red as a background wash, no threat badges, no countdown pressure. The confirmed anti-reference for this system.
Don't use a gradient, glow or shadow on a popup card, or a tonal card on top of a card.
Don't introduce a second accent, a purple/indigo gradient, or a glassy translucent surface.
Don't round a container above 12px (chips and the switch aside) or add a 2px border.
Don't set anything below 11px outside the format chips, and don't set a weight other than 400/600 outside a status glyph.
Don't signal state with color alone, or replace a text status line with an icon.
Don't restyle a native checkbox or a native select into custom markup — tint the platform control.
